`[추가]` Modbus TCP 통신 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` EtherNet/IP 통신 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` MC Protocol 통신 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` TCP/IP Socket Client·Server 통신 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` 통신 데이터 실시간 모니터링 및 제어 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` PC에서 테스트 화면을 구성할 수 있는 HMI Builder를 추가했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.0 (2026.11.21)
items: `[개선]` Windows용 Rust 버전으로 전환했습니다. Excel과 JSN을 변환하고, 네 가지 라벨 양식에서 저장 전 라벨을 확인·편집할 수 있습니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.2.0
items: `[수정]` Excel 라벨 영역의 행 높이를 18로 통일했습니다.
`[수정]` 일부 라벨명이 파란색으로 표시되던 문제를 해결하고 글자색을 검은색으로 통일했습니다.
`[수정]` 비트 라벨 영역의 셀 테두리가 사라지던 문제를 해결했습니다.
`[수정]` 라벨명과 설명의 정렬이 서로 다르게 표시되던 문제를 해결하고, 왼쪽 정렬과 세로 가운데 정렬로 통일했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.1.0
items: `[수정]` 동일한 주소에 Bit·Byte·Word 라벨이 함께 존재할 때 일부 라벨이 누락되거나 덮어써지던 문제를 수정했습니다.
`[변경]` 주소 충돌 시 Bit 라벨을 우선 표시하고, 관련 Byte·Word 라벨은 설명 영역에 함께 표시하도록 변경했습니다.
`[추가]` 설명에 포함된 `Double Word`, `2 Word`, `DWORD`, `32-bit` 표기를 자동으로 인식하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[수정]` Double Word 데이터가 Excel에서 32-bit 범위로 올바르게 병합되도록 수정했습니다.
`[변경]` 프로그램 제목과 실행 파일의 버전 정보를 V2.1로 통일했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.0.0
items: `[신규]` 개별 버전으로 제공되던 라벨 포맷을 하나의 프로그램으로 통합했습니다.
`[추가]` `20글자 Word / 20글자 Byte / 64글자 Word / 64글자 Byte` 포맷 선택 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` Excel → JSN과 JSN → Excel 화면에서 각각 포맷을 선택할 수 있도록 했습니다.
`[신규]` JSN 데이터를 Excel로 변환하기 전에 라벨명과 설명을 확인·수정할 수 있는 편집 화면을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` 선택한 포맷에 맞춰 생성되는 Excel 파일명을 자동으로 지정하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[변경]` 20글자 포맷에서는 긴 변수명을 자동으로 축약하도록 변수명 표준화 기능을 개선했습니다.
`[변경]` 현재 선택된 포맷과 불러온 데이터 개수가 상태 영역에 표시되도록 변경했습니다.
`[변경]` 기본 포맷을 `20글자 Word`로 변경했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.0.0
items: `[신규]` Excel 라벨 데이터를 JSN 파일로 변환하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` JSN 파일을 Excel 라벨 양식으로 생성하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` Input·Output의 Bit·Byte·Word 라벨 변환을 지원합니다.
`[추가]` B·R·D 변수 라벨 변환을 지원합니다.
`[추가]` 라벨 목록 조회·정렬·선택·수정 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` 변수명 표준화와 변경 전 미리보기 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` `64글자 Byte`와 `20글자 Word` 양식을 지원합니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.0 (2026.11.21)
items: `[개선]` 밝은 파형 화면을 적용했습니다. A/B 커서를 실선과 점선으로 구분하고, 선택한 구간의 채널별 최솟값과 최댓값을 표시합니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.5 (2026.07.25)
items: `[수정]` 배터리 사용량 모니터링 항목을 제거했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.4 (2026.07.18)
items: `[추가]` 3D 시뮬레이션을 위한 가상 컨트롤러 연동 서버 기능을 추가하였습니다.
`[추가]` Joint 위치 값 실시간 모니터링 항목을 추가하였습니다.
`[추가]` 측정 항목 창을 열거나 닫는 버튼을 추가하였습니다.
`[수정]` 트레이스 창이 일정 너비 이하로 설정된 경우 항목이 표시되지 않던 문제를 해결하였습니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.3 (2026.07.15)
items: `[추가]` J1~J6 축 속도 실시간 모니터링 기능을 추가했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.2 (2026.06.15)
items: `[신규]` DI·DO 각 16채널의 실시간 모니터링 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[변경]` 디지털 신호 상태를 숫자 대신 `ON / OFF`로 표시하도록 변경했습니다.
`[개선]` DI·DO 신호의 변화를 쉽게 확인할 수 있도록 그래프 표시 범위를 최적화했습니다.
`[개선]` 선택한 모든 추적 채널을 CSV 파일로 저장할 수 있도록 개선했습니다.
`[개선]` CSV 파일을 불러올 때 포함된 채널을 자동으로 인식하고 화면에 표시하도록 개선했습니다.
`[개선]` 기존 버전에서 저장한 CSV 파일도 계속 불러올 수 있도록 호환성을 유지했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.1 (2026.05.18)
items: `[변경]` B·R·D 변수를 모두 읽는 방식에서 사용자가 선택한 변수만 수집하는 방식으로 변경했습니다.
`[추가]` 트레이스 실행 중에도 B·R·D 추적 변수를 변경할 수 있도록 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[개선]` 불필요한 로봇 API 호출을 줄여 고속 샘플링의 안정성과 응답 속도를 개선했습니다.
`[개선]` 실시간 트레이스 중 로봇과 프로그램에 발생하는 통신 부하를 줄였습니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.0 (2026.04.26)
items: `[신규]` InoRobotTrace를 최초 출시했습니다.
`[신규]` 로봇의 TCP 속도와 현재 위치를 실시간으로 추적하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 에러 상태·에러 코드·축별 서보 에러·비상정지 상태를 모니터링하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 프로그램 라인·모션 라인·시스템 시간·펌웨어 버전을 확인하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` Tool·Work Object·Load 번호와 B·R·D 변수를 모니터링하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 그래프 확대·이동·채널 분리·커서 측정 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 트레이스 데이터를 CSV 파일로 저장하고 다시 불러오는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[배포]` 별도의 설치 과정 없이 실행할 수 있는 단일 실행 파일로 제공됩니다.

versions.title: Ver 3.0 (2026.11.21)
items: `[개선]` Windows용 Rust 버전으로 전환했습니다. 코드 비교 화면에서 Ctrl 키를 누른 채 휠을 돌려 양쪽 코드와 줄 번호의 크기를 조절할 수 있습니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.2
items: `[신규]` 동시 스크롤을 켜거나 끄고, 양쪽의 현재 위치를 기준으로 스크롤을 맞출 수 있는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 이름이 다른 프로젝트 A/B 파일을 선택하여 직접 비교할 수 있는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 프로젝트 한쪽만 불러와도 같은 프로젝트의 프로그램을 양쪽 창에서 확인할 수 있는 보기 전용 모드를 추가했습니다.
`[변경]` `MovJ`, `MovL` 등 이동 명령어를 비교 강조색과 구분되는 청록색으로 표시하도록 변경했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.1
items: `[변경]` 125%, 150% 등 Windows 화면 배율 환경에 대응하도록 디스플레이 설정을 변경했습니다.
`[수정]` 고해상도 모니터에서 글자·버튼·입력창이 겹치거나 크기가 비정상적으로 변하던 문제를 수정했습니다.
`[변경]` 별도의 .NET 설치 없이 실행할 수 있도록 단일 실행 파일 배포 방식으로 변경했습니다.
`[변경]` 프로그램 제목과 실행 파일의 버전 정보를 V2.1로 통일했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.0
items: `[신규]` 두 InoRobot 프로젝트를 나란히 비교하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 프로그램 파일(`.pro`), 포인트 파일(`.pts`), 설정 파일(`.jsn`, `.dat`) 자동 분류 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 파일 상태를 `일치 / 불일치 / A에만 존재 / B에만 존재`로 구분하여 표시합니다.
`[신규]` 서로 다른 코드와 데이터를 색상으로 강조하는 비교 화면을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 포인트와 라벨 데이터를 표 형태로 비교하고 편집하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 선택한 파일을 A → B 또는 B → A 방향으로 덮어쓰는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 비교 화면에서 파일을 직접 수정하고 저장하는 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[신규]` 기존 프로젝트를 복사하는 `다른 이름으로 저장` 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` 한국어·영어·중국어·베트남어 UI를 지원합니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.1 (2026.11.25)
items: `[추가]` 프로젝트 변수의 이전 값과 변경 값, 진단 시작 시점의 I/O 상태, 커널 네트워크 링크의 복구 시간, 알람 직전의 스레드 주기를 확인할 수 있습니다.
`[개선]` 반복 로그와 연쇄 알람을 기본으로 한 건씩 표시합니다. 체크하면 묶어 볼 수 있으며, 선택한 알람의 안전정보에서 원문으로 이동할 수 있습니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.0 (2026.11.21)
items: `[개선]` 알람별 로봇 모드와 축 상태, 연관 로그를 한곳에서 확인할 수 있습니다. 프로그램 탭에 태스크 현황과 라벨·위치 데이터 표를 추가했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.1 (2026.11.04)
items: `[추가]` 시스템 진단 ZIP·폴더 분석, 오류·서보 알람 조회, 트레이스 그래프·A/B 측정 및 보고서·CSV 저장을 지원합니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.0 (2026.11.21)
items: `[개선]` SolidWorks 설치 없이 SLDPRT와 SLDASM을 직접 열 수 있습니다. STEP으로 저장할 때 부품 배치와 부품별·면별 색상을 유지하고, GLB에도 표시 색상을 반영합니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.3 (2026.11.03)
items: `[추가]` 포함한 부품을 색상·배치·좌표계를 유지한 GLB 파일로 내보낼 수 있도록 했습니다. 합친 부품은 하나의 메시로 저장하며, 현재 미리보기 품질을 적용합니다.
`[추가]` 선택한 여러 부품을 위치·색상·정밀 형상을 유지한 하나의 부품으로 합치고 STEP으로 저장할 수 있도록 했습니다.
`[개선]` 모델 트리에서 부품·그룹을 이동하거나 이름을 바꾸고, 편집한 트리 구조를 STEP 저장에 반영할 수 있도록 했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.2 (2026.10.30)
items: `[추가]` 영점 좌표축을 모델의 면·직선 모서리에 평행 또는 수직으로 맞추고, X+/X−/Y+/Y−/Z+/Z− 방향을 지정할 수 있도록 했습니다.
`[개선]` 여러 축의 맞춤 조건을 유지하면서 기준 방향·반대 방향을 즉시 적용하고, 고정된 맞춤을 확인하거나 해제할 수 있도록 했습니다.
`[개선]` 영점·좌표계를 적용하면 선택한 위치가 새 0,0,0이 되며, 여러 번 적용한 변경도 STEP 저장에 반영되도록 했습니다. 면 스냅을 지원하고 대용량 모델의 일부 부품에서 스냅이 제한되던 문제를 해결했습니다.
`[추가]` Ctrl+Z·Ctrl+Y로 부품 숨김·표시, 전체 포함·제외, 영점·좌표계 변경을 되돌리거나 다시 실행하고, Delete 키로 선택한 부품을 숨길 수 있도록 했습니다.
`[추가]` 드래그 선택 버튼과 Alt+왼쪽 드래그로 사각형 선택을 지원합니다. 드래그 방향에 따라 완전히 포함된 부품 또는 일부가 걸친 부품을 선택할 수 있습니다.
`[개선]` 숨긴 부품을 선택한 동안에는 3D 화면에 임시로 표시하고, 선택을 해제하면 다시 숨기도록 했습니다. 임시 표시는 STEP 내보내기 포함 상태를 바꾸지 않습니다.
`[개선]` 그룹을 자동으로 펼치지 않고 선택 부품이 포함된 상위 그룹을 표시하며, 여러 항목을 선택한 뒤 한 번에 숨길 수 있도록 했습니다.
`[수정]` STEP 가져오기와 부품 제외·원점·축 방향 변경 후 저장할 때 원본 부품·면 색상이 바뀌거나 누락되던 문제를 해결했습니다. 색상 정보가 없는 부품은 회색으로 표시합니다.
`[수정]` STEP을 그대로 저장하거나 부품 제외·원점·축 방향 변경 후 저장할 때 파일 크기가 불필요하게 증가하던 문제를 해결했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.1 (2026.10.23)
items: `[추가]` 하위 항목들을 그룹으로 묶어 관리할 수 있도록 그룹 만들기 기능을 추가했습니다.
`[수정]` 다운로드한 ZIP 파일을 빈 압축파일로 인식하던 문제를 해결했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 1.0 (2026.07.25)
items: `[신규]` 대용량 STEP/STP 파일을 PC에서 직접 불러와 부품별로 확인할 수 있는 경량 CAD 도구를 추가했습니다.
`[추가]` 선택한 부품만 STEP 파일로 저장할 수 있도록 지원합니다.
`[추가]` 파일의 영점 위치를 수정할 수 있습니다.

versionHistory.title: InoRobot Assistant Update History
versionHistory.intro: This file records user-visible feature additions, content updates, display changes, and fixes for each card on the home page.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.21
items: `[Improved]` Every page downloads about half as much translation data when it first opens, so pages appear sooner.
`[Fixed]` The Servo System Solution page now appears in Chinese, Turkish and Russian instead of Korean.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.20
items: `[Improved]` Buttons, icons and selected items on the home and tool pages now use the blue of the INOVANCE logo. Titles next to the logo use the selected language and the same font and size across pages.
`[Improved]` The home page shows all eight tools. Use Selection, Design, Control or Resources to find the tools for your task.
`[Improved]` All five home guides now use a light player. Each step highlights the relevant control and explains what to do and why. You can move to any step.
`[Improved]` Model filters and document searches respond faster. Calculating mass properties for large STEP models and comparing project files also takes less time.
`[Improved]` Release notes on the home and debugging pages now share a light layout that keeps versions and changes readable on small screens.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.05
items: `[Changed]` Disabled automatic GitHub regression checks on push.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.31
items: `[Improved]` Reduced validation waits for small changes by checking the affected areas.
`[Improved]` Grouped version history entries by change category within each release date.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.23
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed some version history entries being labeled "Info" instead of their change type.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.14
items: `[Added]` Added a Servo System Solution card to the homepage and a servo motion control guide available in English and Vietnamese.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.30
items: `[Fixed]` Communication Tester now downloads as a ZIP file, fixing the executable that could not be downloaded.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.28
items: `[Improved]` Added automatic checks for purchase-code and download mappings and generated robot programs.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.24
items: `[Added]` Added Turkish and Russian language support to the website.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.06
items: `[Changed]` The creator notation at the bottom of the main homepage has been changed to `Designed & Developed by Jeongchan Lee | INOVANCE Korea`.

versions.title: Ver 26.08.13
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the outer white square border of the website circular logo was visible.

versions.title: Ver 26.08.12
items: `[Improved]` Innorobot, Innovance Robot, INOVANCE robot We have improved the homepage SEO to make it easier to find the site with search terms.
`[Changed]` homepage search title `Inovance Robot Assistant | Changed to Innovance Korea`.
`[Added]` Added a circular logo icon to identify your website in Google search results.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.21
items: `[Improved]` SCARA cards compare Z-axis stroke and standard cycle time side by side for standard and cleanroom versions. Each version opens its own model and specifications, with ISO Class 4 shown for cleanroom models. Articulated robot cards show repeatability, and the detail view lists allowable wrist torque by axis.

`[Improved]` The robot body and standard cable use the robot quantity. Optional components have their own quantities, and articulated robot I/O cables are included only when selected. Selecting PROFINET or CC-Link also selects its expansion card and keeps both quantities in sync.

`[Improved]` When no type is selected, hardware options appear below the robot models. They can be added to the configuration list on their own, with editable quantities. Each card groups its items by function. Expansion cards are grouped by communication, I/O and safety, and the R7H calibration tool has its own order code. Teach pendant extension cables can be added from both the Pendant and Other Accessories cards. Click a hardware item row to select it. SCARA J3 covers are available for standard and clean S4, S7 and S10 models.
`[Improved]` Excel exports show configuration and robot totals and combine order quantities into one row per purchase code.
`[Improved]` Buttons and selected items appear in blue on light panels.
`[Added]` Each robot now has a searchable detail page and unique address that supports sharing, reload and browser history while preserving configuration.

`[Improved]` Large model images are smaller, so the model list and detail window open faster. Specification rows in the detail window are separated by lines, and per-axis repeatability appears in the selected language.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.31
items: `[Updated]` Updated the robot CAD files with the latest DWG and STP drawings.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.28
items: `[Fixed]` Resolved incorrect purchase-code display for R15H and R20H.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.24
items: `[Changed]` Component lists and saved configurations in Robot Model Select now download as Excel files.
`[Changed]` Added a Type column to distinguish robots, pendants, accessories, and cables in the Excel list.

`[Changed]` The Excel list now distinguishes articulated, SCARA, and ceiling-mounted SCARA robots and Arm I/O connection locations; robot details show whether the Power/Encoder cable is movable or non-movable and its length.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.22
items: `[Added]` Set the quantity of robot model and paid accessories and list multiple configurations for download as final configuration details.
`[Fixed]` Adjusted the position of the configuration list button so that it does not overlap with the language change button.

`[Fixed]` Resolved an issue where PROFINET and CC-Link could not be selected together in the communication option expansion card, and corrected the quantity display of pendants with protective covers and the robot quantity aggregation of the robot body option.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the 5m, 10m, and 15m models of the pendant with emergency stop protection cover were not displayed and the purchase code was displayed incorrectly.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.14
items: `[Fixed]` The robot body RJ45 port paid option has been deleted from model selection.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.12
items: `[Changed]` cable configuration has been changed to display flexible/flexible type as movable type, and basic type/non-flexible type as non-movable type.
`[Added]` Cable set `1504UP81`·`1504CU41`, which consists of both Arm I/O and Body I/O, has been added to the R15H·R20H model.
`[Changed]` The hollow type designation of the 6-axis robot was changed from `Yes/None` to `Hollow/Non-Hollow`.
`[Changed]` The notation `Yes/No` of the clean type filter was changed to `Basic type/Clean type`.
`[Fixed]` When the clean type filter is selected, 6-axis robots that support the clean type body option are also displayed.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.09
items: `[Fixed]` The problem where J4·J5·J6 speeds were displayed incorrectly in R10H model selection has been corrected to `470°/s`·`438°/s`·`764.7°/s`.
`[Fixed]` In R15H·R20H model selection, the problem where the default IP grade was displayed incorrectly has been corrected to `IP54` and `IP67` is displayed as a selection option.

versions.title: Ver 26.08.13
items: `[Added]` Added a guide for this feature.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.28
items: `[Added]` Dedicated 2D, 3D CAD files that are downloaded when selecting the pendant emergency stop protection cover type have been added.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.26
items: `[Improved]` CAD The download button has been improved to be activated immediately.
`[Changed]` CAD Changed models without files to be displayed immediately as `CAD No files`.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.25
items: `[Added]` GL20 Series 6 models were separated from the controller expansion card and added as a remote coupler option.
`[Changed]` Cleaned up the multilingual display of the cable pin count display and option configuration details, and modified the purchase code to display in a new group.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.20
items: **[Changed]** Added compatible controller model numbers to the model selection screen.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.18
items: **[Added]** Korean, English, Chinese, and Vietnamese are now supported, and all items previously displayed in English in certain Korean views have been translated into Korean.
**[Changed]** The version-labeling convention has been changed to record the date only.

versions.title: Ver 26.06.19.01
items: **[New]** Added the IR-TP200 teach pendant with an emergency-stop protective cover.
**[New]** Added order codes for covered pendants: 5 m 01640069, 10 m 01640072, and 15 m 01640073.
**[Changed]** Reorganized pendant selection into Not selected / Without protective cover / With protective cover.
**[Changed]** The result and PDF now show the selected pendant cover, length, and order code.

versions.title: Ver 26.06.15.01
items: **[Added]** Added 5 m cable order code 01741079*M00018 for IR-S7-60Z20S-INT.

versions.title: Ver 26.06.02.01
items: **[Changed]** SCARA models without KCs certification now show an estimated lead time of 10 weeks.

versions.title: Ver 26.06.01.02
items: **[Changed]** Renamed model IR-R15H-145S-INT to IR-R15H-145S-K-INT.
**[Changed]** Renamed model IR-R20H-120S-INT to IR-R20H-120S-K-INT.
**[Added]** Added IR-R15H IP67 order code 01741446.
**[Added]** Added IR-R20H IP67 order code 01741597.
**[Added]** Added 3 m cable order code 01741436*M00002 for IR-S25-100Z42S-INT.
**[Added]** Added IR-S60-120Z40S-INT order codes: 5 m 01741367*M00002 and 15 m 01741367*M00003.
**[Fixed]** Restored CAD lookup after the R15H and R20H model-code changes.

versions.title: Ver 26.06.01.01
items: **[Added]** Added 3 m cable order code 01741086*M00008 for IR-R10-140S-INT.

versions.title: Ver 26.05.29.01
items: **[New]** Added Standard, Clean, and IP67 body options for six-axis robots.
**[Changed]** R10-140, R16, and R25 now show only the fixed Body IP65 / Wrist IP67 specification.
**[Changed]** R15H and R20H Clean models show ISO Class 4; other six-axis Clean models show ISO Class 3.
**[Changed]** Selecting a body option now updates the S/C/P model code and PDF filename.
**[Fixed]** Fixed CAD downloads for R16, R25, and other models using _CN or _3D_CN filenames.
**[Fixed]** Restored °, °/s, mm, and mm/s units in axis speed and motion-range values.
**[Fixed]** Restored kg and mm units for mass and repeatability in details and PDFs.
**[Fixed]** Removed incorrect KC and KCs certifications from IR-S35-80Z42S-INT.
**[Cleanup]** Removed unreleased IR-CS models from filters and search results.
**[Cleanup]** Hid the unsupported Handheld Motor Brake Release Box option for R10-140, R16, and R25.

versions.title: Ver 26.05.22.01
items: **[Changed]** Corrected Clean Type from Yes to No for IR-R4H, R7H-70, R7H-90, R10H, R15H, and R20H.
**[Changed]** Clean specifications for those six-axis models are now shown as selectable options rather than defaults.
**[Changed]** Updated the estimated lead time for Clean SCARA models to six months.
**[Fixed]** Enabled CAD buttons for R16 and R25 where model codes differ from CAD folder names.
**[Changed]** Standardized CAD button labels as Checking / CAD Download / CAD Not Ready / Preparing.

versions.title: Ver 26.04.17.01
items: **[Fixed]** Corrected swapped Standard and Clean data for IR-S25-120.
**[Fixed]** Corrected model name, arm length, Z stroke, mass, cycle time, and certification links for IR-S35-100 and IR-S35-120 variants.
**[Added]** Added 2D DWG, 3D STP, and FBX files for IR-S25-120Z42S-INT and IR-S35-120Z42S-INT.
**[Fixed]** Corrected IP ratings for R15H and R20H in generated PDFs.

versions.title: Ver 26.04.12.01
items: **[New]** Added recommended circuit-breaker capacity to model details.
**[Changed]** Ratings now show R4/R7H 10 A, R10/R11 15 A, R10-140 20 A, R16/R25 30 A, S25 15 A, and S35/S60 20 A.

versions.title: Ver 26.03.31.02
items: **[Changed]** Pendant, Arm I/O, Body I/O, and communication expansion order codes now use orange badges.
**[Changed]** IR-TP200 extension-cable names now show 5 m, 15 m, and 25 m lengths directly.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.26
items: `[Support]` The web simulator can connect virtual vision to controllers over Socket or EtherNet/IP using bridge V2.2. The bridge ZIP contains a single executable.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.25
items: `[Fixed]` The JOG panel now keeps the decimal point and minus sign when typing a joint value.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.24
items: `[Added]` On K14 builds with virtual bus support, link the web conveyor to its master. Each workpiece can be claimed by only one robot.
`[Improved]` Open conveyor, motion settings, vision and IO mapping panels now follow changes to targets and settings. Selections and unfinished edits are preserved in detached windows as well.
`[Improved]` Conveyor motion is smoother when transporting many workpieces at once.
`[Improved]` SCARA spindles, S7 exterior parts, and six-axis robot tool flanges more closely match the physical parts.
`[Changed]` Removed the 60 FPS limit switch from the top toolbar. Previously saved limits still apply.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.23
items: `[Improved]` The updated K14 virtual controller and Bridge V2.1 send joints, TCP and outputs together at a target of 60 Hz. Vacuum changes between frames retain their corresponding poses.

`[Fixed]` K14 conveyor tracking checks vacuum contact against the workpiece position at the robot pose timestamp. This fixes placement offsets after high-speed pickups. Display interpolation delay is down from 48 ms to 16 ms.
`[Fixed]` The conveyor sensor laser and status light stay green while a workpiece remains detected, even after selecting a model.

`[Fixed]` With vacuum on, the pad picks up one workpiece within 0.5 mm and holds it until release, even while tracking a moving conveyor. Contact is also detected at an angle and between display frames.
`[Fixed]` 3D Simulation button icons appear even when the external icon server is unreachable.
`[Fixed]` The J2 cable fitting swivels with the cable on SCARA models equipped with an external conduit.
`[Fixed]` Pressing Delete or choosing Delete in the model tree context menu removes all selected models at once.
`[Fixed]` During K14 conveyor tracking, the robot’s A-axis orientation now reflects the workpiece angle detected by virtual vision.
`[Fixed]` Conveyor markings and workpieces now use the same display time, reducing jumps in workpiece motion even when the robot is stationary.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.22
items: `[Improved]` Collision checks during motion and jogging, and vacuum distance checks, run 2 to 4 times faster in scenes with many large models.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.21
items: `[Added]` Import SolidWorks parts (.SLDPRT) and assemblies (.SLDASM) directly. The simulator requests a folder when an assembly needs referenced parts and reconstructs standalone parts from their saved bodies when the display mesh cannot be read.
`[Added]` Enable Reduce surface flicker in the model tree to bring the selected part's display depth forward for overlapping surfaces such as labels and housings.
`[Improved]` Model move snapping commits the new position when you select the second point. The Apply, Cancel, and Select Again buttons were removed from the placement panel.
`[Added]` Hold Space with a non-robot model selected to show its move handle.

`[Improved]` Outlines of large models are calculated about 10 times faster when they load. Snap points and the model edges used for curve-path teaching are also calculated faster for large STEP models.

`[Improved]` Auto quality speeds up first-time conversion of STEP files from 20 MB to under 50 MB. Files of 50 MB or more show parts as they finish converting. STEP models under the Test button load faster using preconverted meshes.

`[Fixed]` In other languages, the motion settings window, the empty Trace chart message, program IO commands, the group name prompt, conveyor button and window tooltips, some error and status messages and undo button descriptions no longer appear in Korean. The sketch text box and an empty point list show their hint text instead of an internal key name.
`[Fixed]` Reopening the motion of a part group from the model tree now edits the existing motion instead of opening new settings.
`[Fixed]` Adding a robot to a scene with 3D models no longer shifts its default position along the Y axis.
`[Fixed]` The Connect, Disconnect and Delete buttons in the Controller Connection list no longer occasionally ignore clicks.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.20
items: `[Added]` Record the 3D scene from the View panel as a 16:9 WebM video at 60 fps, with the model tree and floating panels excluded. Wider views keep their full height and are cropped equally on both sides.

`[Added]` Start, pause and resume recording with one button. Finish and save separately. Review the current or last recording on the timeline, split or delete clips, drag their edges to trim them, and set the stopwatch start and end points.
`[Fixed]` Clicking empty space beside a Cartesian jog arrow or rotation ring no longer starts a robot drag. Hover over a draggable arrow or rotation ring to highlight it in orange.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.18
items: `[Improved]` The 3D workspace, model tree and JOG panel now use a light palette. On small screens, open panels from the bottom toolbar.
`[Improved]` Fullscreen bars open from an area half as tall as before. The top bar opens after the pointer stays near the edge for at least 0.5 seconds, and the bottom bar opens immediately.
`[Added]` Delete selected positions together in P.pts, with undo and redo. The Delete key and detached window are also supported.
`[Fixed]` Removed remaining INOVANCE lettering edges from robot outlines on affected models.
`[Improved]` Curve-based trajectory generation clearly highlights selected curves and selects face boundaries with one click.

`[Added]` Set and save length, width and height for test models including bases, conveyors, objects, stages, teaching kits and trays. Defaults match the original model dimensions. Regular conveyors also show belt markings that follow their motion.
`[Improved]` Conveyor auto-feed varies each workpiece’s lateral position and rotation for vision correction trials. Adjust both ranges while preserving belt boundaries and minimum spacing.
`[Fixed]` Continuous conveyor operation and auto-feed now continue when switching applications, hiding the panel or closing its detached window, until Stop is pressed.

`[Added]` Conveyors can continuously feed registered objects at a specified gap. Generated objects are collected in a group that is collapsed by default and cleaned up after passing the outlet. Feed settings and group state are saved with the workspace.

`[Changed]` The dedicated Virtual Controller Bridge is now versioned as V2.0, shown in its window, file properties and download link. Minimizing keeps it running in the notification area; double-click its icon or use its menu to reopen the window.

`[Fixed]` Conveyor sensors support IN0–64 on K14. An empty, untracked virtual belt can switch from test drive to web control. Rejected links now explain pending objects, robot tracking, or conflicting vision sources.
`[Added]` When OLP runs, a per-cycle table shows the time of each move and the wait before it, highlights the longest move, and can be saved as CSV.
`[Added]` Connect web conveyor encoders, sensors and vision detections to a K14 virtual controller for conveyor tracking in robot programs.
`[Improved]` Exposure-time encoder latches compensate for vision processing delay, and conveyor settings are saved with the workspace.

`[Added]` Test conveyors with adjustable speed, forward/reverse direction, continuous run, hold-to-run JOG and stop controls. Scene tests work without a bridge; when tracking is linked, the same motion drives encoder input. The test Conveyor model also shows belt markings circulating around its ends at the selected speed and direction, stopping when JOG is released or Stop is pressed.

`[Added]` Create a configured conveyor tracking test scene with workpieces, a laser sensor and a downward-facing vision camera. Before connecting a controller, inspect the laser position and detection colors, and save or restore the sensor settings. Conveyor vision supports optional automatic capture based on sensor detection and belt travel, as well as CnvTrigVis requests and manual capture. The conveyor module contains Conveyor, Vision camera and Sensor subgroups for collective or individual selection and movement. The belt is 2.5 times longer and 1.5 times wider, with the sensor and camera near the infeed.
`[Added]` IO Test In[0]–In[64] switches DI0–DI64 on the selected K14 virtual controller and displays confirmed input feedback. Disconnected or failed reads are shown as unavailable.

`[Added]` Added Virtual Vision with upward/downward capture and color live images. The test Vision module automatically uses its Camera parts for upward capture. After 9-point and rotation-center calibration, Capture measures X, Y and angle offsets from the master position once. Supports K12 virtual-controller calibration export, CALRAW/PIXEL raw-coordinate TCP commands and a robot BASE coordinate conversion example. Vision images exclude robot coordinate axes and 3D manipulation handles. Supports TCP communication with RobotLab calibration using its default V terminator.

`[Added]` Select a work object to move and rotate the existing model randomly around its reference position. Default deviations are ±50 mm in X/Y and ±180° in angle; basic work-shape generation is also supported.

`[Added]` In object motion settings, you can assign a home Output number to return the object to its home position by IO. You can also home all registered objects at once, or have objects placed with a random X/Y and rotation offset within a set range when homed. The Set as Home button registers the current position as the new home.

`[Added]` Virtual Vision communicates with real and virtual controllers on its own IP over Socket or Ethernet/IP. Select a server/client role and press Connect for a single connection attempt, with robot example programs generated from the settings.

`[Added]` Added a flat tray module to the test window. Its uninterrupted 240×240 mm surface supports freely positioned and rotated objects for vision capture and picking. Educational model generation also places it at the initial position X=650, Y=350, Z=0 mm.
`[Fix]` Fixed an issue where object home IO mappings targeting a specific object were deleted when work was reloaded.

`[Added]` Educational model generation now automatically mounts a Single VAC Tool as a Tool on the selected robot. The educational Single VAC Tool uses TCP Z=100 mm on articulated robots and Z=-100 mm on SCARA robots. SCARA adapters initially load at Z=12 mm.
`[Fix]` Fixed missing INOVANCE logos on R4H and some other robot models.

`[Added]` Added automatic position generation by clicking edges and curves in the 3D view. Set spacing, first point number, direction and offsets, preview coordinates, then save or export them through P.pts.
`[Fixed]` Motion management, I/O mapping, conveyor and test model panels now show instructions and status in the selected language.

`[Fixed]` Reconnecting the web conveyor preserves encoder counts and queued workpieces, and retries detections without duplicating objects when acknowledgements are lost. Web conveyor linking also recovers after the K14 virtual controller restarts.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.03
items: `[Fix]` Fixed an import failure while processing face colors in some large STEP files.
`[Fix]` Fixed GLB models exported by CAD_Lightweight importing too small to see.
`[Fix]` Fixed robot body collision detection against GLB, STEP and scene models, allowing only normal contact at the base mounting surface and flange/tool mounting interface.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.02
items: `[Added]` Added a standardization mode to the Program Panel to automatically generate P variable numbers and labels for new motion commands.
`[Fixed]` Fixed model copies retaining renamed names without a copy number or inheriting the selection highlight color.
`[Fixed]` Fixed part coordinates not restoring correctly when undoing or redoing movement from the model tree.

`[Fixed]` Fixed copied objects appearing at different heights after entering the same position. Unified movement from the 3D view and model tree while preserving existing project placement and registered reset poses.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the Tool detaching from the robot or jumping when the user coordinate system changes during controller program execution.
`[Fixed]` Disabled unwanted autocomplete suggestions when entering numeric values.
`[Fixed]` Fixed mounted Tools shifting slightly and invalidating calculated TCP positions after multi-point snapping or Tool offset edits.
`[Fixed]` Fixed P.pts export not working when its panel was opened in a separate window.
`[Changed]` Tool and Wobj data now exports as `ToolParam.dat` and `WobjParam.dat` files.
`[Fixed]` Fixed view panning, rotation and zoom being blocked while selecting a Tool suction face.
`[Changed]` Removed stop and reset commands from the model tree context menu for Tool actions.
`[Fixed]` Fixed snap points being displayed but not selectable when moving models from the model tree.
`[Fixed]` Fixed undo and redo being disabled while connected to a controller, and missing undo history for Tool action settings and model color changes.
`[Added]` Added deletion of saved settings from the controller connection list.
`[Improved]` Increased the vacuum pickup tolerance to 2 mm and fixed missed pickup signals or positions when rendering is delayed.
`[Fixed]` Fixed zoom slowing down with rotation around the selected model and navigation remaining slow after resetting the view.
`[Improved]` Saved Tool TCPs with non-default offsets can now be selected as snap points alongside the current TCP.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.31
items: `[Added]` Added R35-185 and R50-250 robots with PI2.0 colors and INOVANCE logos to the 3D simulation.
`[Added]` Added snap points at the base mounting-hole centers of all robot models.
`[Improved]` Improved face shading and subtle contact occlusion on 3D models to make shapes and depth easier to distinguish.
`[Fixed]` Fixed original colors changing on imported 3D models and missing part or face colors in large STEP files.
`[Fixed]` Fixed arm-load models not aligning with their mounting references across all robot models.
`[Improved]` Limited arm-load attachment axes to J3/J4 for six-axis robots and J2 for SCARA robots.
`[Added]` Added Base, Tool and Wobj coordinate selection for Cartesian translation and rotation in the JOG panel.
`[Fixed]` Fixed Wobj editor targets and active indices being mixed between robots in multi-robot scenes.
`[Added]` Added coordinate axis visibility controls to Tool and Wobj settings, available while connected to a controller.
`[Fixed]` Expanded Tool component trees and fixed components in some STEP Tools being merged into one part, preventing individual motion settings.
`[Added]` Selecting a face during a move from the model tree now displays the model origin as a selectable snap reference.
`[Improved]` Enabled interference zone and TCP detection range imports and fieldbus IO monitoring for virtual controllers, skipping unsupported items.

`[Added]` Added an object reset button beside Save in the registration and editing form, plus a context menu action, to restore registered position and rotation. IO mappings can reset selected or all registered objects.
`[Fixed]` Fixed TCP offsets displacing newly imported Tool models by mounting them at the flange origin (0, 0, 0).

`[Added]` Expanded saved views to 10 slots with a separate transition time beside each view name. Applying a view, IO mappings, and program View commands all use the time saved with that view. Fixed-view windows now fill the available space without a header, with unframed control icons overlaid inside the view. Rotation around the selected object can be enabled separately in each fixed view. 3D JOG handles are hidden in fixed views.
`[Fixed]` Fixed views disappearing or freezing when Always on top was enabled after opening them in a separate window.

`[Improved]` Expanded TCP setup to Tool 0–15 with load information viewing, individual or combined model load import and robot program code copying. Combined loads recalculate total mass, center of gravity and inertia. Tool and Wobj icons turn green for nonzero indices, and the Work Origin icon turns green when the robot reaches its work origin.

`[Improved]` Added coordinate editing, origin snapping and robot program code copying relative to Wobj 0, and enlarged the 3D coordinate display. Unified the Tool and Wobj setup layouts and colors and removed unnecessary fields.

`[Fixed]` Fixed controller configurations being lost when reopening a project. Virtual controller default IPs now follow configuration order, and connection lists, types, IPs, sources, and target robots are restored without connecting automatically.

`[Fixed]` Fixed multiple selection in the model tree and 3D view to follow Windows behavior: Shift selects a range, and Ctrl adds or removes individual items. Removed the model name from the bottom bar and placed the status at the far left. Pressing Esc now clears selected models and parts together.
`[Fixed]` Fixed point markers and labels in fixed views changing size when zooming the main view.
`[Added]` Added a List button to the left of Reset to reopen and load saved simulation projects.
`[Improved]` Applied PI2.0 colors to robot models.
`[Fixed]` Removed outlines from INOVANCE logos on robot models while preserving body outlines.
`[Fixed]` Removed a small fragment that appeared detached behind J3 on the R16 robot.
`[Fixed]` Fixed right-drag panning slowing down when zoomed in.
`[Added]` Added fine mouse rotation, panning and wheel zoom with Shift, and twice-normal speed with Ctrl.

`[Added]` Added per-robot P.pts position registration and overwrite, table editing with Windows-style multiple row selection, shortcuts, range copy/paste and undo/redo, movement to selected positions, and P.pts export. Supports automatic standardized numbers and labels, a list that expands with the window, and a separate window.
`[Fixed]` Fixed controller entries disappearing from the list after disconnection, allowing reconnection with the same settings.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where STEP parts merged in CAD_Lightweight were split into multiple parts again when imported.
`[Fixed]` Fixed merged STEP parts failing to import due to surface color errors.
`[Improved]` Fixed one robot’s Tool IO affecting another robot’s actions. Tool actions and sensors now use their own robot’s IO, while shared scene mappings remain active when any controller is ON.
`[Fixed]` Fixed existing actions being replaced when adding another action type to the same model. Multiple actions can be configured and managed individually, with independent IO connections.
`[Fixed]` Fixed brief view freezes when picking up, releasing, or resetting objects. Also reduced delays when vacuum acquisition starts.

`[Improved]` Objects now only need registration. Tool vacuum actions select a contact face or entire part and vacuum/release signals. Objects within 1 mm are searched once on activation, follow robot and cylinder motion, and remain attached until released.
`[Improved]` Fixed cylinders, external axes, and film peeling stopping midway when the motion signal turns off. A single signal pulse now keeps each action moving to its target.
`[Fixed]` Fixed long controller disconnection messages causing horizontal scrolling in the connection panel.
`[Fixed]` Fixed renamed models and parts still showing their original names in motion settings and Tool, object, conveyor, and load selection lists.
`[Fixed]` Fixed Tool quadrant snap heights differing at a level pose while connected to a virtual controller.
`[Fixed]` Fixed simulation stuttering with collision detection enabled in scenes containing models with many parts.

`[Improved]` Action names are editable, and registered actions can be tested from the model-tree context menu. Removed the moving-target section and gripper option, and arranged IO settings into condition, output, and input rows.

`[Improved]` RapidMove timing now accounts for model-specific dynamics, loads, acceleration/deceleration and ramp settings for R7H, R10H, R25, R15H, S4, S7, S10, S25 and other supported robots. Improved OLP Tool settings and consecutive Z[0] motion handling.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an incorrect Tool reference frame on ceiling-mounted TS robots.
`[Added]` OLP now runs process, teaching, recipe, background PLC and vision communication programs produced by Project Generator, with configurable virtual vision replies.
`[Fixed]` Improved OLP linear paths and Tool/Wobj coordinates, and fixed unnecessary waits accumulating during repeated command execution.
`[Fixed]` Fixed OLP motion continuing while paused and global variables or recipe selections being lost after Stop/Start.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.27
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed snap movement and face alignment being blocked for an unconnected robot when another robot is connected to a controller.
`[Fixed]` Fixed importing 3D models automatically resetting the current view.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.23
items: `[Improved]` Reduced the angular appearance of curved STL surfaces on simulation robot models.
`[Added]` Added 3D teaching markers with selectable ID and label text and selection linked to the program list. Teaching positions, hidden positions, and text labels are shown by default.
`[Fixed]` Fixed TCP readings differing from the actual position because of controller calibration. Received TCP values are displayed directly, while joint feedback determines the robot posture.
`[Improved]` INOVANCE logos on all robot models now use the brand color.
`[Improved]` Reduced unwanted outline fragments inside robot models and softened the outline color.
`[Fixed]` Fixed Always on top not working after opening a view in a separate window.
`[Improved]` Fixed unnecessarily winding or failed automatic paths, and improved obstacle detours and TCP orientation hold.
`[Improved]` The position value dialog no longer blurs the background and can be moved by dragging.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the fourth 6-axis arm parameter always showing 1 regardless of pose and SCARA J4 turns being applied incorrectly, following the manual definition.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.21
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed missing collision indicators on some robot bodies and shafts during simultaneous contact between multiple robots.
`[Fixed]` Fixed sphere and rectangular TCP monitoring shapes being swapped when importing settings from the controller.
`[Improved]` Improved interference zone and TCP monitoring settings dialogs so they can be moved by dragging their title bars.
`[Fixed]` Fixed TCP monitoring boxes showing interference or stop colors even when outside the interference zone.
`[Fixed]` Fixed four-point TCP monitoring height to extend along flange Z− for articulated robots and flange Z+ for SCARA robots.
`[Fixed]` Fixed controller position updates freezing when simulation interference was detected. Received controller positions continue updating while local interference is shown as a warning.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.20
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed the camera view flipping when wheel zoom passed the orbit center.
`[Added]` Doubled zoom speed when dragging with the wheel button held and added fine zoom with Shift+wheel.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the part options menu not opening for imported 3D assembly groups and the model tree jumping to the top when hiding a part.
`[Fixed]` Fixed JOG using the previous position after moving the robot from the program panel.
`[Fixed]` Fixed simulation projects containing large models failing to save.
`[Improved]` Taught program points now move to their saved Cartesian coordinates using the current TCP and Wobj settings.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the browser context menu appearing in the simulation view, model tree and program panel.
`[Fixed]` Fixed missing collision detection between robot bodies when controlling multiple robots.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.19
items: `[Added]` Added simultaneous joint/BASE JOG, 3D handle motion and zero return when two or more robots are loaded. BASE JOG moves and rotates selected robots in the same spatial direction as the reference robot, regardless of their installation orientation. Fixed JOG panel headings appearing in English instead of the selected language.
`[Improved]` Fixed JOG targets and checkboxes failing to follow robot selection when Select All is off. Turning off Select All now keeps only the selected robot as the JOG target.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.17
items: `[Fixed]` Prevented snap selection from triggering when releasing the mouse after dragging the model tree move handle.
`[Fixed]` Large STEP assemblies now retain their individual parts and nested assembly structure.
`[Improved]` Virtual controller IP addresses can now be edited; selecting a real controller defaults to 192.168.0.1.
`[Improved]` Restored zoom around the existing view center when selected-model rotation is disabled, resolving awkward view navigation.
`[Fix]` Fixed snap operations selecting a model behind a snap point and changing the snap location.
`[Fixed]` Improved view navigation with selected-model rotation disabled and fixed zoom slowing down during repeated zooming.
`[Added]` Fixed snaps appearing on models without a selected face and added quadrant snaps to circles on selected faces.
`[Improved]` New controller connection settings can now be opened regardless of robot availability or existing connection status.
`[Improved]` Reduced mouse-wheel zoom increments and middle-button drag sensitivity for finer view scaling.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the tool mounting zero shifting with TCP coordinates after controller connection.
`[Added]` Added an always-on-top option to keep the fixed-view window above other applications.
`[Improved]` Default rotation preserves camera distance at the world origin, while panning or wheel zoom keeps the view center fixed and moves only the camera.
`[Fixed]` Fixed another robot’s controller connection incorrectly locking the selected robot’s TCP settings.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.08
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed the flipped J4 posture when aligning a six-axis robot perpendicular to a selected face. Equivalent wrist configurations now prefer J4 closer to zero while preserving the TCP position and orientation.
`[Fixed]` Fixed wheel zoom slowing near the orbit center during repeated zooming. Zoom now uses the model surface under the cursor.
`[Fixed]` Switching between straight-line and orthogonal dimensions after selecting P1 and P2 now retains both points without requiring P2 to be selected again.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.07
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed OLP IO test inputs failing to retain ON/OFF states or refresh their display, and virtual bus InW values not reaching the program.
`[Fixed]` Fixed OLP motion ignoring the Tool number and the selected TCP position and rotation offsets.
`[Added]` Controller Out[0]–Out[16] feedback now drives the IO test display, equipment such as vacuum and grippers, and IO mappings.
`[Improved]` Vacuum pads now acquire objects when the surface gap is within 0.1 mm.
`[Fixed]` Fixed simulation endpoint differences by using received TCP position and rotation, including TCP and Wobj, and improved screen updates during controller position synchronization.
`[Added]` Reset all now restores registered objects to their initial positions and rotations.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.05
items: `[Added]` The model tree supports part and model group folders, Shift multi-selection, drag reordering and renaming. Select a group to move or rotate everything in it together.

`[Added]` Motion settings for cylinders, linear and rotary external axes, grippers, vacuum and conveyors. Link several parts and IO/completion sensors; equipment follows the robot Tool or its parent equipment.

`[Added]` Object registration and vacuum pick and release. Grippers, vacuum and conveyors act only on registered objects, and the previous grab/release actions are replaced by motion settings and IO control.
`[Added]` A peeling motion: the gripper grabs the tab and pulls off a single film. After the film is fully removed, open the gripper to drop it.
`[Added]` IO output and wait-for-input commands in programs. IO Test can map equipment motions to signals and control them.
`[Added]` Previews of test models and tools, loading by quantity, and one-click placement of the training layout. Loaded parts appear in prepared group folders.

`[Improved]` SCARA test tools mount their adapter automatically, and the training layout adds a raised base. Short-reach robots are placed so they reach the work positions while keeping module spacing.
`[Added]` An overall speed control in the Program panel applies a 1–100% ratio to the speed of every move command.
`[Added]` A selection-centered view that pans and orbits around the selected model.
`[Improved]` Collision detection now focuses on contact between the robot's Tools/objects and surrounding models, so contact between fixed equipment no longer stops the simulation.
`[Improved]` Faster STEP model import and better outline display on curved robot surfaces.
`[Fixed]` Wobj no longer becomes disabled after a project is loaded.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.01
items: `[Improved]` JOG TCP position and rotation readouts, coordinate entry, and movement buttons now use the selected Wobj frame. The bottom Wobj button shows the active number.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.30
items: `[Added]` Ctrl-click a part to select its whole model. Tools, arm loads, and grip objects select their own attached model.
`[Fixed]` Snap points on robot-mounted Tools were not displayed during dimension measurement, movement, and other snapping operations.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.24
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed OLP runs stopping on `WaitInPos;` and native browser context menus appearing for P.pts rows during OLP execution.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the BASE button in the JOG panel not toggling the handler visibility when clicked again.
`[Fixed]` Fixed excessive OLP text logs for routine motion, status, and IO changes.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the issue where starting the simulation virtual environment opened two CMD windows.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.23
items: `[Added]` Added Trace to measure program, OLP, and controller status for multiple robots at selected intervals, with charts and CSV export.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where dimension measurement could not be used while a program was running.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the issue where a controller-connected robot prevented motion from running in the Program Panel on another robot.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where a controller connected to one robot blocked OLP project import and execution on another robot, leaving its selected-robot pause and stop controls unavailable.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the controller-connected robot being shown as Program ready in the Program Panel.
`[Fixed]` Fixed OLP applying the robot installation height twice to `Wobj[0]`, moving Z below the point, and ignoring JUMP `LH/MH/RH` settings.
`[Fixed]` Fixed JUMP segments with no actual movement still consuming the minimum motion time.
`[Fixed]` Fixed OLP `Z[CP]` corner blending and continuous JUMP paths not being reflected in the robot motion.
`[Fixed]` Fixed SCARA arm posture switching between left and right because OLP did not apply point arm parameters to IK.
`[Improved]` Sketch entities now follow the pointer in real time while dragging in Select mode, and selected text shows an outline.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the source sketch being shown as a separate duplicate model-tree item after sketch extrusion.
`[Fixed]` Fixed dimension-constrained sketch geometry moving along a locked axis when dragged, so it moves only along unconstrained directions.
`[Fixed]` Fixed the extrusion height showing as 0 when starting extrusion from the sketch editor and set the default to 100.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where a guest who joined a collaboration room could not claim a robot or connect a controller, and robots added after room creation were not displayed.
`[Improved]` Improved collaboration performance by interpolating remote robot states and reducing unnecessary repeated collaboration-panel updates that caused visual stuttering.
`[Fixed]` Fixed claimed collaboration robots being overwritten by remote state updates and manual JOG positions not appearing on the other participant's screen.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the same P point number was moved to the Z position of another file instead of the active point file's position when multiple point files had the same P point number.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.22
items: `[Improved]` Added a sketch text tool so users can enter text directly and set its position, text height, and rotation angle.
`[Fixed]` Fixed sketch text being treated as an extrusion profile.
`[Added]` A text tool has been added that allows you to directly enter text in sketch mode and specify the position, character height, and rotation angle.
`[Fixed]` Fixed sketch text not being incorrectly treated as extruded profile.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the rectangle center point snap was not displayed on sketch extruded shapes.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where when moving a shape, the snap points of the move target shape and the created base shape were not displayed.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.21
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where some complex STEP files were treated as having no displayable mesh and could not be imported.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the straight-line length, orthogonal dimension, and robot position options were not displayed in the dimension measurement panel while a controller was connected.
`[Improved]` Improved 3D Simulation so multiple 3D files can be imported by dragging them in at once.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where TCP position snapping was limited to the robot body center and TCP point instead of allowing any desired position on a 3D surface.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.16
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the initial guide text remained in the center and the load was shown as failed after loading a robot model.
`[Changed]` Removed the Wobj coordinate option from the JOG panel so JOG movement operates only in the BASE coordinate system.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where other coordinate entries could not be selected in Wobj settings.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the Wobj[1]~[15] buttons did not select a coordinate frame when clicked.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.15
items: `[Improved]` Solved an issue where the 3D simulation top and bottom buttons and status information overlapped or were cut off when the screen width became narrow.
`[Improved]` In the model tree, clicking on an already selected item again will deselect it.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the 500mm unit dimension text in the 3D simulation floor grid would appear in front of or partially over the model surface.
`[Improved]` Modified to allow additional loading of other models while loading 3D files.
`[Added]` IO Test function has been added so that virtual input can be reflected in the program.
`[Added]` Added robot position to the dimensioning method, allowing you to snap to a point and display X/Y/Z coordinates relative to the selected robot.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where activating the TCP path line in OLP would not display the breadcrumb path.
`[Improved]` When there are multiple robots, OLP has been modified so that the project can be applied individually to each robot.
`[Fixed]` OLP Solved an issue where the selected robot could not be started, paused, or stopped together even if the entire model control button was pressed.

`[Fixed]` OLP We have resolved the issue where a notification asking whether to allow folder copying was displayed when loading a project, so that it will be loaded immediately when a folder is selected.
`[Fixed]` Solved an issue where the test/sketch mode/3D file loading at the top did not work while running the program.
`[Fixed]` Solved an issue where deletion and some model editing functions could not be used in the right-click menu of the model tree while running the program.

`[Added]` Wobj[1]~[15] coordinate system settings for each robot and WOBJ JOG were added to the 3D simulation, and the OLP·interference area position value was made to apply the selected Wobj coordinate system.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.14
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where snap points were not created on internal holes in sketch extruded shapes.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the center of a hole in a sketch extruded shape could not be selected by virtual center point snap.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where snapping points of sketch extruded shapes were not recognized in dimensioning and model placement.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where changing robots would be disabled even if there was an active robot with a different model or blank screen selected.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where robot body center point and zero position could not be snapped in sketch mode.

`[Fixed]` Solved an issue where, when extruding only some sketch profiles and then editing the sketch again to extrude other profiles, the shape was created diagonally offset from the sketch position.

`[Fixed]` The right-click menu of a 3D shape created with a sketch is different from that of a regular shape, so we have resolved an issue where tool/arm load registration and color change could not be used.

`[Fixed]` When snapping a robot model, we solved an issue where vertices, edges, and faces of the robot mesh were displayed as snap candidates, and modified it to display only the body center point and TCP points.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where robot snap candidates would disappear when selecting a face on a different model and then clicking the robot again or reselecting it in the model tree.
`[Added]` Added a gauge to check step-by-step progress while loading a 3D model.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.11
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the options window was displayed after switching views by right-clicking on the 3D screen.
`[Added]` Added the ability to save and load the entire 3D simulation work along with the 3D model as a `.inosim` file.
`[Changed]` Saving/loading of the program panel has been changed to only process motion programs created in the program panel, rather than the entire simulation.
`[Fixed]` Solved an issue where a room could not be created because the collaboration server did not run in a virtual environment.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the collaboration button was disabled if no robot model was selected.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the Connect New Controller button would be disabled after creating or joining a collaboration room.
`[Changed]` The maximum number of participants in the 3D simulation collaboration room has been expanded from 2 to 4.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.10
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the R11 P6 link and TCP wobbled away from the rotation center when only J6 was rotated in Joint mode.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.08
items: `[Added]` DXF A 2D CAD sketch function has been added that allows you to extrude/cut by loading a file or drawing a drawing directly.
`[Added]` Added the function to create 3D shapes.
`[Added]` Added an option to set the transparency of a selected model or part in the model tree.
`[Added]` Added the function to measure dimensions.
`[Added]` Added an automatic path creation function to the program panel that checks for 3D model interference between two locations and creates an automatic avoidance path.
`[Added]` Added a two-person collaboration feature where two computers can participate in the same 3D simulation, each controlling a different robot.
`[Added]` Added WAIT command to synchronize program execution positions of multiple robots and display of program line numbers to program panel.
`[Added]` Functions and program commands have been added to the program panel and model tree to implement the actions of holding and dropping objects with tools.
`[Added]` Added the TCP path line function to the program panel, which displays the TCP movement trajectory during program execution.
`[Improved]` We have improved the ability to register/unregister 3D models and shapes loaded from the model tree with Tools.
`[Improved]` We have improved the collision detection function and added a display function instead of stopping when a collision occurs.
`[Improved]` controller connection function has been improved to allow connection to multiple robots at the same time.
`[Improved]` In the program panel, the OLP function has been improved to control multiple robots simultaneously.
`[Improved]` Improvements have been made to calculate the mass, center of gravity, and moment of inertia based on the input mass or material of each part of the tool attached to the robot.
`[Improved]` Movement, snapping, and dimension editing in the model tree have been improved to allow direct adjustment of the position and size of selected parts.
`[Improved]` Improvements have been made so that other programs and functions can be edited/used even while the program is running.
`[Improved]` Improved collision detection performance.
`[Changed]` Changed all snap icon colors from yellow to red.
`[Improved]` Removed snap radius selection function.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.02
items: `[Changed]` Changed the default so collision detection is disabled when starting a new simulation.
`[Improved]` Improved unnecessary delays during 3D model import.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.01
items: `[Added]` Added the arm load feature (payload installed on the robot arm).

versions.title: Ver 26.08.13
items: `[Added]` Added a guide for this feature.
`[Fixed]` Updated the SCARA robot cable conduit height and modeling.
`[Fixed]` Updated the initial 3D Simulation screen so the Program Panel is not displayed.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where browser OLP could not connect to the Communication Tester because it could not obtain Virtual Bus authentication information.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where Virtual Bus reconnection stopped in OLP without a project or disconnected about 30 seconds after connecting.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where communication disconnected once when starting an OLP program while Virtual Bus was connected.

versions.title: Ver 26.08.12
items: **[Fixed]** Resolved an issue where the controller API could not load on PCs without the Visual C++ 2013 runtime installed.
**[Fixed]** Resolved an issue where the controller connection would intermittently disconnect.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.26
items: `[Added]` Added OLP (Offline Programming) function to the program panel.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.25
items: `[Improved]` The large STL model uses separate collision proxies from the original mesh for visual purposes, improving both collision checking performance and display quality.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the virtual controller was not connected.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.24
items: `[Added]` A function has been added to detect collisions based on actual shapes between robot link, tool, and equipment models, and to display the collision models in red.
`[Added]` An interference area setting function has been added that can be used by setting a virtual area at a desired location.
`[Fixed]` SCARA J3's controller angle range was applied to each model and modified so that the simulator's linear axis (mm) and the controller display value (°) match.
`[Added]` A function to batch initialize save settings and batch models has been added.
`[Added]` Added physical controller connection function.
`[Added]` A multi-view function has been added that allows you to open saved camera views in a separate window and check multiple views simultaneously in split screen.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.21
items: **[Added]** Added Auto, Lightweight, Standard, and High quality choices for large 3D model imports.
**[Changed]** Large STL, FBX, and STEP models are processed in the background and chunks, while STEP part structure and colors are preserved.
**[Fixed]** Stabilized selected-face, multi-point-center, and candidate snap feedback while navigating the model.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.18
items: **[Revamp]** The existing 3D Viewer has been comprehensively rebuilt as 3D Simulation, enabling robot simulation.
**[Support]** All robot models can be moved, and robot motion paths can be set through programming.
**[Support]** Supports importing 3D models and attaching imported files to a robot Tool.
**[Support]** Can connect to and use the InoRobotLab Virtual Controller. (Requires the dedicated bridge or Trace tool.)
**[Added]** Korean, English, Chinese, and Vietnamese are now supported, and all items previously displayed in English in certain Korean views have been translated into Korean.
**[Changed]** The version-labeling convention has been changed to record the date only.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.22
items: `[Improved]` Outlines of large STEP models are calculated about 5 times faster.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.21
items: `[Improved]` Snap points such as vertices, circle centers and face centers are calculated faster when a large STEP model is loaded.
`[Fixed]` On small screens the judgment table no longer runs off the page; scroll it sideways to see every column.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.20
items: `[Improved]` Buttons and selected items appear in blue on light panels.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.27
items: `[Improved]` Disabled the unused J5-to-flange distance input when a SCARA model is selected to avoid confusion.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.03
items: `[Changed]` Removed the no-longer-needed snap-radius setting from Mode D.
`[Changed]` Changed all Mode D snap icon colors from yellow to red.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.01
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where exporting any STEP file failed immediately after import, even without changes.
`[Improved]` Improved the delay that occurred when loading 3D CAD in Mode D.

versions.title: Ver 26.08.14
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where Mode D displayed only snap candidates near the pointer after selecting a CAD face.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue that prevented the Mode D 3D view from freely rotating 360 degrees in every direction.
`[Improved]` Added robot suitability evaluation using Mode D STEP CAD calculation results.

versions.title: Ver 26.08.13
items: `[Added]` Added a guide for this feature.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue in Mode D where a snap candidate from a different location than the clicked CAD face could be selected.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.26
items: `[Improved]` Improved mobile web UI layout.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.21
items: `[Added]` You can select the import quality of large STEP files from basic to ultra-light.
`[Fixed]` Fixed 180° boundary continuity and face, circle, and arc snap calculations for the rotation handle.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.18
items: `[Added]` STEP/STP CAD Added Mode D to calculate mass properties for files.
`[Added]` Set inclusion/material/density for each part and calculate total mass, CoG, and Ixx·Iyy·Izz based on tool origin and load center.
`[Added]` Tool The origin and TCP can be specified as a vertex, end point, center point, or virtual intersection snap.
`[Added]` The direction of the coordinate system can be set using the 3D rotation handle and Rx·Ry·Rz values.
`[Added]` Displays TCP and CoG in different colors and shapes and provides a legend in the 3D viewer.
`[Added]` 3D Viewer Grid Provides ON/OFF buttons, default is OFF.
`[Added]` You can export a STEP file with the specified tool origin and coordinate system direction applied.
`[Added]` Added multi-circle center point snap, which selects 2 to 4 circle/arc center points to calculate the average center.
`[Changed]` Apply material/density settings and coordinate system STEP Export retains original CAD colors.
`[Added]` Supports Korean, English, Chinese, and Vietnamese, and all items displayed in English in some Korean versions have been translated into Korean.
`[Changed]` The version notation has been changed to record only the date.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.21
items: `[Improved]` Styles and icons are now part of the site and guide images load only when the guide opens, so the generator opens faster without external scripts. The Project Options description area and the guide backdrop match the other light dialogs.
`[Fixed]` The number column in the process list no longer shows a word meaning "none" in Chinese, Vietnamese, Turkish and Russian.

versions.title: Ver 26.11.20
items: `[Improved]` Buttons and selected items appear in blue on light panels. The live source preview shows comments in green and distinguishes commands, strings, numbers and functions by color.
`[Added]` Import an existing project ZIP or folder to modify processes and options, preserve custom code and taught points, review conflicts, and export the complete modified project as a ZIP.

`[Added]` A separate project for the 3D simulation can be downloaded. It removes PLC signals, IO waits, teaching, recipes and monitoring tasks, replaces tool and vision replies with set times, and runs the chosen process order for a set number of cycles.

`[Fixed]` Socket-based Tray Get and other processes, including Vision Calibration, now add received Socket data to the process base offset instead of using vision IO offsets. Calibration process programs receive Shot data before applying the offset.
`[Fixed]` Fixed Socket settings failing to open when selecting Use - Socket for vision offsets in Tray Get and other processes.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.31
items: `[Fixed]` Generation now rejects imported settings with more than eight extra wait positions, preventing duplicate point numbers in process programs and P.pts.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.17
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed the missing R20H model in the project generator.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.07
items: `[Added]` Added X/Y counts and pitches for Tray processes. Generated s02_offset.pro now calculates Tray offsets; labels and Excel include INW[37] xwTray_index, and user alarm 12 includes ERR : Tray Count Error!. The generated IO map Excel filename now uses the generation date. Tray offsets are omitted for processes with zero or one cell.

versions.title: Ver 26.10.06
items: `[Changed]` Renamed position labels in generated P.pts, initialization and process programs from `Pn_Up` / `Pn_Down` to `Pn_Pre_work` / `Pn_Work`.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.24
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the current position could be updated before reaching the Wait position, causing the return path to be misidentified.

versions.title: Ver 26.09.03
items: `[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the Project Generator header was translated into Korean, Chinese, or Vietnamese instead of remaining in English.
`[Fixed]` Fixed an issue where the ZIP file downloaded only after confirming the project-generation completion alert; it now downloads immediately after generation.

versions.title: Ver 26.08.13
items: `[Added]` Added a guide for this feature.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.26
items: `[Fixed]` On the Korean screen, `No` is displayed as `number`, `Process` is displayed as `process`, and the process method names `Get`·`Put` are not translated. It has been modified so that it does not work.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.18
items: **[Added]** Korean, English, Chinese, and Vietnamese are now supported, and all items previously displayed in English in certain Korean views have been translated into Korean.
**[Changed]** The version-labeling convention has been changed to record the date only.

versions.title: Ver 26.07.12.01
items: **[Fixed]** Added Break; after Save so the loop and Teach mode end correctly.

versions.title: Ver 26.06.19.01
items: **[Changed]** Teaching Offset X, Y, Z, A, B, and C now show data format 2 Word /10000.

versions.title: Ver 26.06.15.01
items: **[Changed]** Teaching Mode, Wait Position, and Process Busy are enabled by default.
**[New]** Added next, previous, offset-position, and save-current-position actions to Teaching Mode.
**[Changed]** Wait and Work Position now have separate Start, Complete, and Busy states.
**[Fixed]** Corrected the application order when Vision Offset and Process Offset are used together.

versions.title: Ver 5.0 (2026.11.21)
items: `[Improved]` Moved to Rust for Windows and applied a blue theme to the robot communication, HMI, and frame monitor views.

versions.title: Ver 4.0 (2026.11.04)
items: `[Improved]` Combined virtual and physical connections in one program, with an independent connection mode for each controller.
`[Improved]` Provided C1-C4 by default, using 127.0.0.1-4 for virtual connections and 192.168.0.201-204 for physical connections.
`[Improved]` Added import of existing controller settings, HMI layouts, and function code, with saved connection modes and settings.
`[Changed]` Changed the program UI to English and simplified the controller and protocol tabs.
`[Fixed]` Fixed missing default buttons when an empty HMI layout was saved. The previous file is backed up before restoring the Basic and Offset pages.

versions.title: Ver 3.3 (2026.11.02)
items: `[Improved]` Added simultaneous controller connections and controller-specific IO control through one shared HMI.
`[Improved]` Added saved controller names, IPs, connection status and HMI addresses, while keeping other connections running when one target closes.
`[Improved]` Improved controller-specific AND/OR conditions, individual outputs and grouped pulses in function code.
`[Fixed]` Fixed incorrect branch changes and command sequences being cancelled before Wait completed when the start signal cleared.
`[Improved]` Improved function-code editing: line breaks, copy/paste, undo, full-code copying, completion, indentation, syntax help, examples and error-line navigation.
`[Fixed]` Fixed MC D-register addresses not being recognized in function code.
`[Fixed]` Fixed missing IO immediately after EIP connection and intermittent disconnections under load.
`[Fixed]` Fixed UDP port conflicts preventing IO exchange with multiple virtual EIP targets.
`[Fixed]` Fixed delayed IO reflection in the HMI and function blocks, and sluggish screen interaction.
`[Fixed]` Fixed saved empty HMI layouts hiding the default screens.

versions.title: Ver 3.2 (2026.10.07)
items: `[Fixed]` While connected through Virtual Bus, value changes from word inputs and word buttons newly added or configured in the HMI are now applied to the robot.

versions.title: Ver 3.1 (2026.09.02)
items: **[Added]** Added a communication frame monitor to inspect send and receive frames for every communication protocol by structure.
**[Added]** Added a Sequence Builder for configuring and automatically running sequential Process and Position actions in HMI Function Code.
**[Added]** Added conditional wait commands in the `Wait Out[address] == ON, T[time];` format to HMI Function Code.
**[Added]** Added a Pulse command to invert an I/O signal for a specified duration and restore its original state in HMI Function Code.
**[Added]** Added sequence repetition and Current/Average/Minimum/Maximum Cycle Time displays to HMI Function Code.
**[Added]** Added comments using `#` to HMI Function Code.
**[Improved]** Changed Momentary HMI buttons to remain ON for at least 0.3 seconds even when pressed briefly.
**[Added]** Added a frame format guide window that shows the current protocol's frame structure and examples without a connection.

versions.title: Ver 3.0 (2026.08.14)
items: **[Fixed]** Resolved an issue where robot I/O data was not transmitted through EtherNet/IP communication.

versions.title: Ver 2.9 (2026.07.27)

versions.title: Ver 2.8 (2026.07.26)

versions.title: Ver 2.7 (2026.07.24)
items: **[Added]** Added error-code logging when an error occurs.

versions.title: Ver 2.6 (2026.06.15)
items: **[Changed]** Redesigned the default HMI screen for the standardized program changes.

**[Improved]** The embedded default HMI is applied automatically at startup.

versions.title: Ver 2.5 (2026.06.10)
items: **[New]** Added a scripting system to HMI Code Block.
**[Added]** Added If / ElseIf / Else / EndIf conditions.
**[Added]** Added logical, comparison, and arithmetic operators plus Delay.
**[Added]** Scripts can read and write communication-address values.
**[Added]** Added script completion, syntax highlighting, and error checking.
**[Added]** Added Byte and BitField data types.
**[Added]** Word values can be expanded into Bit and Byte child rows.
**[Improved]** Multi-write now handles the data type of each target.
**[Improved]** Improved compatibility with existing HMI files.

versions.title: Ver 2.4 (2026.04.26)
items: **[Changed]** Converted to a self-contained application that runs without a separately installed .NET runtime.
**[Changed]** Combined the application and required components into one executable.
**[Fixed]** Corrected application entry-point and deployment-path settings.
**[Improved]** Improved runtime and deployment stability.

versions.title: Ver 2.3 (2026.04.13)
items: **[Added]** Added condition comparison and execution to HMI Word Button.
**[Added]** Added multi-write for controlling up to ten addresses with one button.
**[Changed]** Condition and execution targets can now be configured separately.
**[Improved]** Improved HMI state and trigger indicators.

versions.title: Ver 2.2 (2026.04.02)
items: **[New]** Published Communication Tester on the website.
**[Added]** Added Modbus TCP communication.
**[Added]** Added EtherNet/IP communication.
**[Added]** Added MC Protocol communication.
**[Added]** Added TCP/IP Socket Client and Server communication.
**[Added]** Added real-time communication-data monitoring and control.
**[Added]** Added HMI Builder for creating test screens on a PC.

versions.title: Ver 2.0 (2026.11.21)

versions.title: Ver 2.2.0
items: `[수정]` Excel 라벨 영역의 행 높이를 18로 통일했습니다.
`[수정]` 일부 라벨명이 파란색으로 표시되던 문제를 해결하고 글자색을 검은색으로 통일했습니다.
`[수정]` 비트 라벨 영역의 셀 테두리가 사라지던 문제를 해결했습니다.

versions.title: Ver 2.1.0
items: **[Fixed]** Prevented Bit, Byte, or Word labels from being omitted or overwritten when they share an address.
**[Changed]** On address conflicts, Bit labels are prioritized and related Byte and Word labels appear in the description.
**[Added]** Automatically recognizes Double Word, 2 Word, DWORD, and 32-bit notation in descriptions.
**[Fixed]** Double Word data now merges correctly across the 32-bit range in Excel.
**[Changed]** Standardized the application title and executable version as V2.1.

versions.title: Ver 2.0.0
items: **[New]** Combined separately distributed label formats into one application.
**[Added]** Added 20-character Word, 20-character Byte, 64-character Word, and 64-character Byte formats.
**[Added]** Formats can be selected independently for Excel to JSN and JSN to Excel.
**[New]** Added an editor for reviewing and changing label names and descriptions before JSN-to-Excel conversion.
**[Added]** Excel filenames are assigned automatically for the selected format.
**[Changed]** Improved name normalization to abbreviate long variable names in 20-character formats.
**[Changed]** The status area now shows the active format and loaded record count.
**[Changed]** Changed the default format to 20-character Word.

versions.title: Ver 1.0.0

**[Added]** Added variable-name normalization and change preview.
**[Added]** Supports 64-character Byte and 20-character Word formats.

versions.title: Ver 2.0 (2026.11.21)
